alt: Me as a small boy in a denim cap and round sunglasses, grinning, one hand out, in front of a red curtain.
Me as a schoolboy in a white shirt and maroon sweater vest, leaning back in the back seat of a car with one knee up.
Me in tortoiseshell sunglasses and a grey sweater, smiling in an open car under a blue sky crossed by contrails.
Me as a boy in a red and white T-shirt, grinning at the camera, a desk and a curtained window behind me.
Me in a navy suit and gold tie, hands in my pockets, on a lawn at Georgia Tech, with red brick, a spire and autumn trees behind me.
Me in a bucket hat, sunglasses and a cream T-shirt, smiling, with the Great Sphinx of Giza behind me.
Me in sunglasses in an open car, a film camera on a strap around my neck, against a blue sky.
